//: Packaging manifest. The ONLY hand-edited file that describes the catalog.
//2: Everything under plugins/ and .claude-plugin/ is generated from this file
//3: plus the sources in skills/, hooks/ and notices/. Run: node build/build.mjs

marketplace.name: miguelaguiardev-skills
marketplace.description: Skills personales para Claude Code: el plugin `toolkit` las trae todas, o instala cada skill por separado

//notices: upstream slug (notices/<slug>.md) -> which skills it covers
//plugins: skills: "*" means every skill. hooks and notices are derived.

plugins.name: toolkit
plugins.description: Every personal skill in one plugin: how-to-chrome (drive the user's real Chrome via CDP), grill-me (stress-test a plan through questions), daily-journal (time-aware development journaling), obsidian-vault (personal markdown notes folder), nudge (time-based reminders), test-driven-development (Logic Gate + Iron Rule TDD), and i-have-adhd (ADHD-friendly output style).

plugins.name: how-to-chrome
plugins.tagline: Manejar tu Chrome real desde la terminal via CDP
plugins.description: Control the user's real Google Chrome (their profile, cookies and logged-in sessions) from the terminal via the Chrome DevTools Protocol: navigate, capture (incl. full page and per breakpoint), read console/DOM, fill forms, export to PDF, annotate elements, and group tabs. No extension, no MCP, no npm dependencies.

plugins.name: grill-me
plugins.tagline: Interrogarte sobre un plan hasta que no queden ramas sin resolver
plugins.description: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design until reaching shared understanding, resolving each branch of the decision tree with a recommended answer at every question.

plugins.name: daily-journal
plugins.tagline: Diario de desarrollo conversacional, consciente de la hora
plugins.description: Time-aware conversational development journal (morning=planning, evening=reflection). Writes structured markdown; Obsidian optional. Ported from ravila4/claude-adhd-skills.

plugins.name: obsidian-vault
plugins.tagline: Convenciones para una carpeta de notas personal (Obsidian opcional)
plugins.description: Folder structure, naming and formatting conventions for a personal markdown notes folder (Obsidian-compatible, Obsidian itself optional). Ported from ravila4/claude-adhd-skills.

plugins.name: nudge
plugins.tagline: Recordatorios por tiempo (parame a las 11, standup en 30m)
plugins.description: Time-based reminders ("stop me at 11", "standup in 30m") via hook + SQLite. Not for process monitoring. Ported from ravila4/claude-adhd-skills.

plugins.name: test-driven-development
plugins.tagline: Logic Gate + Iron Rule: TDD estricto donde hay logica
plugins.description: Logic Gate + Iron Rule: triage what actually needs tests, then strict test-first development for anything with logic. Ported from ravila4/claude-adhd-skills.

plugins.name: i-have-adhd
plugins.tagline: Estilo de salida para lector con ADHD: accion primero, sin relleno
plugins.description: Shape Claude Code output for an ADHD reader: lead with the next action, number steps, suppress tangents, restate state, make wins visible. Ported from ayghri/i-have-adhd.
